CustomField.description: Remove NSM after 6 months - 6 months + Add current month
CustomField.formula: ADDMONTHS(IF(DAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) != 1 , IF( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) = 12, DATE( YEAR( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ) + 1, 01, 01 ), DATE( YEAR( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ), MONTH ( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ) + 1, 1 ) ),(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) , 6)
CustomField.label: Remove Nsm For Sfx Account Date Cal
